decision_authority_grant: Agent may choose implementation details inside inspected constraints; architecture, stack, dependencies, deployment, VCS, acquisition, memory, and policy choices require explicit approval unless listed.
source_originality_policy: Independent implementation for external inspiration; external code or assets only after approval and applicable license, attribution, and notice review.
persistent_memory_boundary: Persistent memory is disabled unless an enabled project policy authorizes the write class; every write also requires a current User request or confirmation, or independent validation under that policy. Provenance is evidence only and never write authority; memory entries record declarative facts, not standing instructions.
source_freshness_policy: Verify current primary sources before recording or using latest/current stable/unpinned versions; use version-scoped docs for pinned versions; use user-supplied material when network acquisition is not approved; check project-approved and framework-approved source registries before duplicate research.
version_review_policy: Keep pinned versions unless the User approves an upgrade review; after an approved source check shows a pin is behind current stable, ask whether to keep, defer, or review upgrade.
version_control_policy: Use the existing repository state; do not initialize repositories or modify VCS metadata without explicit User scope.
branch_policy: Use the current branch unless the User defines a default/protected branch or side-branch workflow.
backout_policy: Prefer the smallest reversible fix; require User approval before destructive VCS, data, migration, deploy, or reset operations.
recitals: This repository is managed with the Master Prompt Agreement framework.
in_scope: Define the initial project contract and active project state.
tech_stack: To be confirmed by repository inspection or User answer.
architecture: To be confirmed by repository inspection or User answer.
framework_verification_runner: REPLACE WITH THE EXACT RUNNER REPORTED BY scripts/check_prereqs.py
language_runtime_standards: To be confirmed before full bootstrap.
acquisition_boundary: No external acquisition unless the project contract approves a method.
code_review_checklist: Keep canonical and operative project files aligned.
Do not duplicate project-specific rules into the runtime entrypoint.
